newsitem.title: USA: Chromcraft to acquire furniture company.
newsitem.headline: Chromcraft to acquire furniture company.

text.p: Chromcraft Revington Inc and Cochrane Furniture Co Inc said Thursday they have signed a definitive merger agreement under which Chromcraft Revington will acquire Cochrane in a transaction estimated to be valued at about $27 million.
The purchase price includes Cochrane's debt assumed in the merger.
Following the acquisition, Cochrane will operate as a wholly-owned subsidiary of Chromcraft Revington.
Under the terms of the proposed agreement, all of the outstanding shares of common stock of Cochrane will be converted into the right to receive a cash amount equal to $4.75 per share.
The acquisition is subject to approval by shareholders of Cochrane, certain regulatory clearances and other conditions.
Cochrane, based in North Carolina, makes and sells dining room, bedroom and upholstered furniture, and had sales of $86 million for the fiscal year ended March 30, 1996.
Chromcraft Revington, with sales of $153 million for the year ended December 31, 1995, designs, makes and sells occasional, casual dining and commercial furniture.
